newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia foreign reserves rise to $8.05 bln Aug 24.
newsitem.headline: Colombia foreign reserves rise to $8.05 bln Aug 24.

text.p: Colombia's net foreign reserves rose slightly to $8.05 billion as of August 24, the central bank reported Wednesday.

Net reserves increased $16.8 million between August 16 and 23, aided by a $27.1 million fall in the central bank's short-term liabilities, which outstripped a $10.3 million drop in gross foreign reserves for the same period.
The balance of gross foreign reserves stood at $8.45 billion and liabilities at $391.6 million.
The balance of net foreign reserves is the difference between gross foreign reserves and short-term foreign liabilities.

In the year to date, the balance of foreign reserves has fallen $270.6 million. The bulk of reserves, $7.56 billion, are held in fixed term deposits in foreign banks and $244.3 million are on deposit with the International Monetary Fund.
